notes: Generated by the generate-goldens-linux workflow_dispatch job in .github/workflows/build-linux.yml from a C-only release build of tag c-reference/final (the last C-capable commit), per the ADR-019 rebuild recipe. The mixed build never generates goldens.
Coverage is the shareware tier only (the runner has no registered, mission-pack or mod data); run_corpus.py --check skips the other entries without failing.
corpus.json pins a sha256 on each entry's required data, and entry_available hard-skips on mismatch, so these goldens are tied to exactly the 1.06 pak0 that fetch_shareware.py produces.
Goldens are derived per-frame FNV-1a state hashes, not game data; the .snd files are the deterministic-DMA mixer PCM chains (--sndhash).

Generated from release builds only; debug builds run the stability gate but are not compared against these (FP results may differ by optimization level, ADR-010). The ADR-010 same-platform rule stands: never compare these against a non-Linux build, and re-dispatch this job if the runner image's compiler or SDL2 changes and --check starts failing on every entry at once.
The headless RNG stream intentionally differs from a windowed run, so these only ever compare headless runs against headless runs.
Never hand-edit. Regenerate by re-dispatching this job.
